title: [BugFix][KV Pool] Skip probes for HBM-cached prefixes
body: ### What this PR does / why we need it? Layerwise hit checks probe pooled blocks even when their prefix is already resident in local HBM. With Memcache, a readability query can synchronously rewarm SSD data or wait for pending rewarm, delaying EngineCore scheduling despite providing no additional external hit tokens. Pass the local hit length into the hybrid coordinator and filter complete local group blocks before constructing backend query keys. Reuse the coordinator's existing HBM hit accounting and apply the same offset to contiguous lookup. Keep partial group blocks and layer-reuse/offload probing intact. Main counterpart of #19754 (`releases/v0.30.0`). ### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change? Yes. Layerwise lookup avoids redundant pool probes and their rewarm side effects for complete, locally resident prefixes. No new configuration or SDK flag changes. This does not change Meta's pending-rewarm cleanup behavior. Release note: `release_notes/fragments/19755.yaml`. ### How was this patch tested? - The release counterpart passed **866 CPU tests, 12 skipped** with `python3 -m pytest -q -rs tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store`. This is supporting release-branch evidence, not a main-branch pass claim. - Five added regression tests cover zero backend calls for fully local prefixes, partial local prefixes with pooled tail extension, missing pooled tails retaining local hits, different group block sizes, and preserved layer-reuse behavior. - Ruff 0.14.0 lint/format checks on both changed main files and `git diff --check` passed. - Main's normal test command could not collect: the development container's vLLM lacks `vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning`. An isolated directory-only attempt also encountered dependency initialization errors; no main runtime test pass is claimed. - GitHub's full `pre-commit` check passed on `97da698f6b4f13802bb14c97a9d42273a8cda1f8`; DCO also passed. `bash format.sh ci` also passed locally on the ARM64 development host for this branch (exit 0, all hooks passed), using the supplied proxy and architecture-correct lint tools; `git diff --check` passed. - NPU correctness, end-to-end behavior and a before/after performance benchmark remain for CI/hardware validation; no measured prefill speedup is claimed. ### Checklist - [x] Boundary / edge-case coverage: complete/partial local hits and different group block sizes. - [x] Regression tests exercise backend query key sets and returned hit lengths. - [x] Missing-pool-tail behavior is covered. - [ ] Main-compatible runtime tests and NPU/performance validation. - [x] Full repository format hooks passed in GitHub CI. - vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c0b6f74bee518aeaf5d72b200a0216e72fbb5e7c --- Need help on this PR?
